package personalteacher

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// Update changes behavior settings without moving student learning state into this service.
type Update struct {
	Teachers repository.PersonalTeacher
	Clock    Clock
}

// Execute applies a partial, optimistic settings update.
func (uc Update) Execute(ctx context.Context, input UpdateInput) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	if input.StudentID == "" || input.ExpectedVersion <= 0 || uc.Teachers == nil || uc.Clock == nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, errors.New("invalid update personal teacher request")
	}
	teacher, err := uc.Teachers.GetByStudentID(ctx, input.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, err
	}
	settings := teacher.Settings()
	applyUpdate(&settings, input)
	if err := teacher.UpdateSettings(settings, input.ExpectedVersion, uc.Clock.Now()); err != nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, err
	}
	return uc.Teachers.Update(ctx, teacher, input.ExpectedVersion)
}

func applyUpdate(settings *domain.PersonalTeacherSettings, input UpdateInput) {
	if input.TeacherProfileID != nil {
		settings.TeacherProfileID = *input.TeacherProfileID
	}
	if input.Language != nil {
		settings.Language = *input.Language
	}
	if input.CommunicationStyle != nil {
		settings.CommunicationStyle = *input.CommunicationStyle
	}
	if input.PedagogyProfile != nil {
		settings.PedagogyProfile = *input.PedagogyProfile
	}
	if input.HintPolicy != nil {
		settings.HintPolicy = *input.HintPolicy
	}
	if input.InterventionMode != nil {
		settings.InterventionMode = *input.InterventionMode
	}
}
